description:
Which SNP haplotypes of a B. napus gene are shared with its diploid progenitors, from the BRAD napus289
resequencing panels (about 283 B. napus with 199 B. rapa on the A subgenome, or with 130 B. oleracea on the C
subgenome; ZS11 coordinates). Per haplotype: B. napus and diploid carrier counts, and whether it is napus-only
(not seen in the sampled diploids: arose after polyploidisation, came from an unsampled progenitor, or is an
introgression). Summary: share of B. napus accessions carrying a progenitor-shared haplotype. gene: ZS11 ID
(BnaA01G0000100ZS), Darmor ID or name, or a curated symbol.
name: napus_progenitor_haplotypes
